6 Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord: 7 (For we walk by faith, not by sight:) 8 We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord. (2 Corinthians 5:6-8 KJV)

Even though the Lord lives within the believer (Galatians 4:6), we have to perceive Him by our faith. We cannot actually see Him and fellowship with Him in the same way as we will when we are out of this world into the spiritual world where He will be manifested to us. We should be “confident” that this will happen when we die, as stated here and elsewhere (Philippians 1:23). The people that teach a “soul sleep” when we die, are not correct, as Paul makes it clear that we go directly to be with the Lord when we die. Thank you Jesus for our salvation.
